thread:
olivia-sales: Hey team — BigBank POC hit repeated 429s during a large embeddings ingest this morning. Happening ~every 10–15m for ~30s. Can we triage?

mike-eng: Can you paste the 429 response body + any request headers (x-ratelimit*) and an example curl?

olivia-sales: Response body: {
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "retry_after": 0.62
}
Curl we used: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d @batch.json`
Headers from client: `X-Forwarded-For: 35.200.10.32`
Server logs excerpt: `429 rate_limited tenant=bigbank route=/v1/embeddings remaining=0 limit=60 reset=168`

jared-sre: Thanks. Two quick suspects: 1) per-route (embeddings) burst window exhausted, 2) tenant token budget met and we’re throttling. Can you confirm batch size and tokens per item?

olivia-sales: Batch size 256 items, avg input ~120 tokens, embeddings response ~0 tokens (we only store vectors). They batch on the client side for throughput.

navin-ml: 256 is big for parallel requests — the runtime will create large spikes. For embeddings we recommend 64 or lower for hosted POC. Also if they do parallel workers the effective concurrency multiplies.

alex-support: I pulled tenant quota: `infra-cli quota show --tenant bigbank` -> `per_route_limit: 60 rps, token_budget_per_min: 250k, burst_window: 60s`. With 256 batches at ~120 tokens that's ~30k tokens per request, so 8 requests hits token budget fast.

mike-eng: That matches. The X-RateLimit-* in logs indicates per-route consumed first (remaining=0). Then token budget enforcement kicked in. Two mitigation paths: reduce batch size / concurrency OR request a temporary per-route and token-budget bump for the POC.

olivia-sales: Customer is on a demo ingest workflow — they want realistic throughput. Can we do a short-lived bump while they validate?

jared-sre: I'll open an ops escalation. What exact bump do you want? Suggest per_route_limit -> 200 rps and token_budget_per_min -> 1M for 2 hours. That should remove the 429s while they finish the ingest.

navin-ml: Also recommend client change: add exponential backoff on 429 with `Retry-After` and reduce parallelism to 8 workers instead of 32. That will smooth bursts without changing infra.

olivia-sales: OK I'll ask BigBank to throttle concurrent workers and reduce batch to 64 as a fallback. But please open the ops ticket now. @sales-ops-bot can you approve a temporary bump?

sales-ops-bot: Request created: INC-4821. Requested changes: per_route_limit=200 rps, token_budget=1,000,000/min, window=2h. Pending SRE approval.

jared-sre: Approved. Applied a soft bump for tenant=bigbank for 2h. Monitor dashboard -> `console.redwood.io/tenants/bigbank/limits` — keep an eye on token burn.

mike-eng: I'll watch logs for the next 30m. If we still see 429s include a `trace_id` from the 429 payload so we can correlate.

olivia-sales: Perfect — I'll coordinate with BigBank and update here. Thanks all :thumbsup:

alex-support: FYI we added a note to the POC runbook: "For large embeddings ingests, use batch<=64, cap workers<=8, enable client-side chunking."

olivia-sales: Update: BigBank reduced batch to 64 and lowered concurrency; 429s stopped within two minutes of the bump. Closing this thread after monitoring window.

jared-sre: Closing — INC-4821 resolved (temporary bump expired). Reverted limits to standard. Leave follow-ups if they want a Dedicated quota for production.
